description: Ghana Dams is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This point shapefile shows the location and names of dams in Ghana. Data originally from the 2008 AICD report. If you have questions about this data please contact gost@worldbank.org. Coverage: Ghana. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2008 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
